title: Analyse des Wasserkraftpotenzials der Gletscherschmelze
by: Federal Council, in fulfilment of postulate 21.3974
note: Entered by hand from the appendix on page 25 (projects included) and the summary on page 3. Only the projects that lie in the Jungfrau-Aletsch study area are listed here. gwh: additional production a year. win: additional controllable winter production a year. art12: provisional SFOE assessment of an exclusion under Art. 12 of the Energy Act. bln, unesco: yes, no or adjacent, as printed. site: id of the ranked site matched by the lake or glacier named, null where the ranking has none.
